name: Five of Swords
keywords: a bitterness that stays even in winning

facts.smirking-man: A red-haired man looks back with a faint smile at the people leaving.
facts.swords-held: He carries two swords over his shoulder and holds one more sword in one hand.
facts.swords-ground: Two swords lie on the ground.
facts.walking-away: Two people walk toward the water with their backs turned, and another seems to cover his face with his hands.
facts.jagged-clouds: Clouds that look torn drift slanting across the sky.
facts.sea: The sea can be seen behind.

glosses.walking-away: The side that lost goes away; the wound the relationship leaves.
glosses.jagged-clouds: The unsettled air after a quarrel.

reversedGloss.waning: The quarrel settles, and a chance to step back or reconcile appears.
reversedGloss.internalized: On the outside it is over, but resentment stays inside.
